messages:
sarah: Heads-up — CI started failing on audit-validator golden fixtures after last night's RBAC + KMS rollout. Failing assertion in keystore events: actor_id !== null. Logs show KMS key id mismatch for ~5 samples. Anyone else seeing this?
jamal: Yep, reproducing locally with the rotation flag set. Seems like when key==rotated_key_id we redact actor_id. Stack snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 'user:123' to equal null
at validateKeystoreEvent (/src/validators/audit.js:212:15)
// event.context.kms_key = "projects/prod/keys/rotated_key_id"
```
alex: I pulled a failing golden from CI. The golden assumes unredacted actor for customer-facing keystore.access events. With KMS rotation we now attach `redaction_token` and set actor_id to null. Two ways forward: update golden fixtures to the new shape, or make validator accept both shapes (preferred for gradual rollout). :thinking_face:
olivia: Support already has a ticket from a COS customer complaining about missing actor in their audit log export (#INC-1234). We should avoid breaking their exports without notice.
skevin: oncall: Can we just roll back the KMS rotation to previous key to stop the CI noise and customer impact?
jamal: Rolling back KMS rotation for prod is high-risk and may break other services that rely on the new key. I don't recommend rollback unless we have to. Safer short-term: patch validator tests to accept optional `actor.redacted` + log a regression alert.
sarah: Agreed — this is more of a schema contract change than a validator bug. We need to treat as a schema semver bump and communicate to customers. Proposal: add optional field `actor.redacted: boolean` and allow `actor.id` to be null when redacted, keep old behavior if absent. That keeps both variants compatible.
alex: I'll open a PR to make the validator tolerant and add unit tests for both variants. Quick patch diff:
```
if (event.actor && event.actor.id == null) {
  assert(event.actor.redacted === true || event.actor.redaction_token, 'redacted actor must include token or flag');
}
```
olivia: Please tag me in PR, I'll coordinate customer comms once we have a temporary mitigant. We should include guidance for customers who consume raw audit streams.
jamal: Also suggest adding an integration test that simulates KMS rotation header so CI can catch this earlier. I'll add infra job to run the golden-fixtures against both `kms_key` values.
sarah: Owners: @alex - PR for validator fix + unit tests, @jamal - CI/integration job and infra patch, @olivia - customer comms. I'll file incident and include risk assessment and rollback criteria.
audit-bot: Incident created: ABC-987 — audit-validator-regression (priority: P2). Linked CI runs: https://ci.internal/runs/987654
alex: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/infra/audit-validator/pull/452 (draft) — adds tolerant schema + compatibility tests. Marking for review.
sarah: Good. After PR merges, we regenerate golden fixtures for the nightly run and add a migration note in the release notes. Let's keep this thread for triage updates. :eyes:
